title: No composite index on messages(chat_id, state_version) for get_changes_since_for_chat
description: MessageStore::get_changes_since_for_chat queries 'WHERE state_version > ?1 AND chat_id = ?2 ORDER BY state_version'. The only available indexes are messages_state_version(state_version) and messages_chat_time(chat_id, created_at). SQLite will use messages_state_version for the state_version filter then scan those rows checking chat_id, or use messages_chat_time for chat_id then scan for state_version. A composite index on (chat_id, state_version) would make this an index-range scan on both predicates. Same applies to the get_querychanges_since_for_chat CTE inner SELECT.
